questions.question: Explain what the base and exponent are in 2⁵, and calculate it.
questions.expected_answer: The base 2 is the number multiplied; the exponent 5 counts how many times it appears as a factor: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 32.

questions.question: Compare 2⁵ and 5², and 3⁴ and 4³. What does this show about swapping base and exponent?
questions.expected_answer: 2⁵ = 32 > 5² = 25; 3⁴ = 81 > 4³ = 64. Swapping base and exponent generally changes the value.
